SQL_DOC.P_SQL: UPDATE KEPCON.ICOMAPRH_IF SET STATUS = $STATUS$ , SUBJECT = $SUBJECT$ , UP_REMARK = $UP_REMARK$ , SECURITY_LVL = $SECURITY_LVL$ , URGENCY_YN = $URGENCY_YN$ , UP_USER_ID = $UP_USER_ID$ , UP_DATE = $UP_DATE$ , UP_TIME = $UP_TIME$ , CONSERVATION_YEAR = $CONSERVATION_YEAR$ , SMS_YN = $SMS_YN$ , SIGN_STATUS = $SIGN_STATUS$ , APR_NO_IKEN = $APR_NO_IKEN$ , IF_FLAG = 'K' , IF_ACT_YN = 'N' , IF_ACT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_ACT_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE APR_NO = '$APR_NO$' AND APR_COUNT = '$APR_COUNT$'
